text:
amanda: RFC follow-up: proposing a lightweight 'attenuation gateway' between rollout controller and runtime to smooth short canary bursts and avoid noisy immediate rollbacks. basic idea: gateway can choose forward | attenuate | degrade | drain based on short windows of signals.

kyle: sounds useful. per-request decision criteria? can't add much latency.

amanda: local signals: p95, error-rate, token throughput; hysteresis 30-90s; per-canary budget. gateway makes O(1) decision. low-confidence -> escalate to control-plane.

rafi: API sketch from controller -> gateway: canary_id, epoch, target_weight, observed_signals; gateway returns action + max_wait_ms + reason_code. idempotent.

tara: define attenuate: soft rate-cap + short queue preserving affinity; if estimated wait > max_wait_ms -> degrade to fallback model. drain stops new canary sessions.

kyle: require operator overrides: redwood rollout hold/resume/force-forward; overrides carry control_seq and audit reason.

amanda: telemetry: export decision events to Kafka, trace span tag attenuation.decision, console timeline with budget burn.

rafi: multi-variant: separate per-variant soft queues + global cap. policy: attenuate -> degrade to sibling -> shift weight.

amanda: action items: rafi sketch control API; kyle operator CLI; tara telemetry plan; amanda update RFC. infra-bot: deploy recorded: canary-controller v1.6.2 -> infra-canary-prod at 2026-03-20T10:02:12Z :rocket:

kyle: thumbs up.

tara: I'll start dashboards.
